desi.title: Indian Wedding Planner Spreadsheet, Mehndi Sangeet Guest List, Desi Wedding Budget, Excel Google Sheets
desi.desc:
Planning a mehndi, haldi, sangeet, wedding and reception, each with a different guest list? This planner keeps every function in one file.

ONE GUEST LIST, EVERY EVENT
• One row per household. For each event mark it blank (not invited), Invited, Yes or No.
• Live counts per event: invited, confirmed, awaiting reply, declined.
• Capacity warning when you invite more people than a venue holds.
• Catering numbers per event by meal type (veg, Jain, vegan, non-veg, child).

SEATING BY SECTION
• Pick the event you're seating, set table sizes and sections (family, mixed, men, women, VIP).
• Counts confirmed guests per table and flags overfull tables.

BUDGET, VENDORS, CHECKLIST
• Budget by category and by event: estimate, actual, paid, balance and due dates.
• Vendor tracker for quotes, deposits and balance dates. Anything due in 30 days shows on the dashboard.
• A checklist of about 50 tasks dated back from your wedding day, including muhurat, pandit, baraat and haldi items.
• An event-day timeline (run of show) for each function.

WHAT YOU GET
• 1 Excel file (.xlsx) with 10 tabs: Start here, Dashboard, Events, Guests (1,000 households), Seating, Budget, Vendors, Checklist, Timeline, Lists.
• Works in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets (free). To use Google Sheets: upload the file to Google Drive, open it, then File > Save as Google Sheets.
• Rename any event, add up to 6, use any currency.

GOOD TO KNOW
• This is a digital download. Nothing is shipped.
• Sample names and numbers are included to show how it works. Type over them or delete them.
• For personal use. Please don't resell or share the file.
• Not tested in Apple Numbers.
• Planning one event only? See our main Wedding Planner in the shop.
• Designed and built by Kova Studio. AI tools helped during the build.

arab.title: Arab Wedding Planner Spreadsheet, Henna Night, Katb Kitab, Separate Hall Seating, Excel Google Sheets
arab.desc:
Gulf and Arab weddings run big: a henna night, a katb al-kitab, a women's hall with hundreds of guests and a men's majlis on the same night. Most wedding planners assume one event and a few tables. This one doesn't.

BUILT FOR SEPARATE HALLS
• Set the women's hall and the men's hall up as two events, each with its own capacity, budget and guest list.
• When a family's men and women go to different halls, give them two rows. Each row counts in the right hall.
• Seat each hall by table and section, with overfull tables flagged.

ONE GUEST LIST, EVERY EVENT
• Room for 1,000 households. Mark each event blank (not invited), Invited, Yes or No.
• Live counts per event, capacity warnings and caterer numbers by meal type.

BUDGET, VENDORS, CHECKLIST
• Budget by event and category, including mahr and zaffa.
• Vendor tracker for deposits and balance dates.
• A checklist of about 50 dated tasks for Gulf weddings: book both halls, zaffa troupe, kosha designer, female photographer, coffee and dates service, ma'dhoun and documents.
• An event-day timeline for each event.

WHAT YOU GET
• 1 Excel file (.xlsx) with 10 tabs. English-language file.
